title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau Doubt at U.S. Open
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau faces uncertainty about his chances to win the U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills this week amid ongoing speculation.

items.headline: Scheffler Notes Course Challenge
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said Shinnecock Hills presents a totally different test from most American major championship venues.

items.headline: Reed Aims to Redeem
items.text: Patrick Reed values PGA Tour players' opinions after leaving LIV Golf and plans to return by serving his suspension and earning his spot the right way.
